test_title: PYST 41: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 15 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster pair DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
The position and positional values or English Alphabets are:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/614a7f51c0c8c0a87e10f870d6d055ce7f479d2bddd28487972b46019d13a26a.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

Each letter-cluster pair follows the pattern +6, +3.

Let’s check each option:

1. UD – AG

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1b38fdafc0e39a25961759b8d3fe09149ef5873b7170bffb1fb98d162123915a.png] 

This letter-cluster pair follows the pattern +6, +3.

2. LU – RX

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/69f55c2eae642fa4be669bf25f34824a616e3afe9dcbd1a6daf8dd384a47fc85.png] 

This letter-cluster pair follows the pattern +6, +3.

3. BK – HN

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a8e48af72595a6075ed48c24fc70453afad2d441e032ee68f493df616aeaacca.png] 

This letter-cluster pair follows the pattern +6, +3.

4. CL – JO

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b987bb0aa9437ebfe3e9cddce93bca5d14910b41f354fc4544e6ac9a8b08f348.png] 

This letter-cluster pair does not follow the pattern +6, +3.

Thus, CL – JO is the odd one out.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 4**".
